verdict.rationale: Mirrors documents its own SDK, installed as an npm package that you wire into your agent's prompt and capture hooks. The docs describe concrete SDK behavior, including a 1,000 ms per-turn timeout you can shorten, background snapshot capture, and appending guidance to the system prompt. Missing for 10: evidence of SDKs in other languages (e.g. Python, despite the listed Python frameworks), SDK API reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install the npm package and connect your agent’s prompt and capture hooks.
The SDK waits at most 1,000 ms per user turn, and you can set a shorter limit.
Capture uploads a full snapshot in the background.
When a correction matches, your code appends that guidance to the next model request’s system prompt.
It works with any agent framework, and your app keeps control of its model calls and tools.
